findings.summary: Anchor variantBindings' texture classification to the exact reached spellings and refuse the rest: the prefix chain took texture_cube_array as a plain cube, texture_depth_cube as 2d depth, and 3d/1d/storage/external through a trailing texture_ catch-all onto a 2d lane, each binding through the wrong view dimension with nothing reporting it. texture_multisampled_2d<f32> keeps its arm because group 0 and group 2 composed variants declare it.

One exported splat container table beside SPLAT_ASSET_KINDS carries loader, module, feature, entry point and parser per kind; the intrinsic case, cli's containerRotation argument and sourceSemantics ternary, the lowerer's four zipped scalars and the emit options' two rotation fields all read one row instead of restating the pairing.
loadSPZ and loadSOG become one fall-through case over that table, replacing ~20 statements duplicated character for character apart from the kind, the feature and the entry point.

observedContainerRotation checks all four container contracts; packageSpz and packageSog stop restating 'exactly one cloud attached' and 'the returned cloud is the attached one', whose messages differed only by the loader name the shared checker already takes. The glTF caller keeps observedRotation, which carries neither container claim.

pinnedBrowserModuleUrl is exported beside pinnedBrowserEntryUrl instead of a third private copy of the pinned sub-module URL rule; pinned-csg2's two raw literals derive from it, byte-identically so its bake key does not move.

packageSog goes through cachedJsonBake, which caches the captured object so a replay still answers all four contracts: measured 3.79 s uncached against 1.99 s cached per scene122 regeneration, and the generation stamp keys on dist, so every compiler edit was paying a Chromium launch.
Hand Buffer.from(base64) straight to packagedSplat: the Uint8Array wrapper copied all 60,539,941 bytes again. packageSpz's neighbouring line wraps an ArrayBuffer, which is a view, and is left alone.

One pair of shape constants on the body, maintained by set_body_collision_shape at all four setCollisionShape sites, replaces two caches and the per-pair per-sub-step fork that re-derived which one was live.

Compare an authored centre in the doubles both sides already hold rather than testing a float32 matrix-quaternion-matrix round trip against identity: a convex-hull body that authors no centre now takes the plain path instead of allocating a compound and paying a compound dispatch level per pair per sub-step. Convex hull is the only shape kind that could reach it, and break-meshes still measures 0.000/0.000.
A to_bt overload for the 4-array quaternion beside the 3-array one, used by apply_body_mass_frame and write_world_transform, whose inline btVector3 also had the helper available.

wear_shared_shape names 'drop the compound, wear the shared shape' once across the two sites 140 lines apart that know a body can wear a compound; physics_body_set_shape's duplicate setCollisionShape call is gone.
Module-level compileNullableNumber and compileNullableVec3 replace three hand-rolled js::Nullable ternaries, including the closure that was private to compileAggregateOptions.
Refuse a node material drawn by a geometry-renderer task, which builds a single-target pipeline for a multi-attachment pass.
findings.blockedBy: The constraint is a relationship between one mesh and one task, not a feature pair: setGeometryTaskMeshes takes a runtime array, so a scene may hold a node material that never enters the geometry pass. Refusing the pair at generation would reject that scene, and no per-mesh material-family lane exists to refuse precisely.

findings.summary: Set MSH_HAS_MORPH_TARGETS for scene-authored geometry under a PBR material, or refuse it: the feature word comes from a synthetic primitive carrying no targets and PBR's runtime mesh bits carry only thin-instance arms, so the mesh renders its bind pose while still compiling and uploading its buffers.
findings.blockedBy: A precise refusal needs per-mesh material family, which is the unbuilt typed material-family lane; a feature-pair guard would wrongly refuse a scene mixing a glTF PBR mesh with a scene-code Standard morph mesh. No registered scene reaches it: of the four that reach mesh:morph-targets, none is PBR and none has a from-data mesh.
